declared_purpose: Analyze GA4 traffic, content, engagement, demographics, conversions and revenue; retrieve Search Console SEO data; request re-indexing and inspect index status. The documented workflow explicitly requires timestamped JSON results and markdown summaries. Supporting source also exposes URL-removal notifications and granular APIs. Particular report fields, duplicate saves, logging and shared authentication scopes are implementation choices.

data_operations.source: Setup instructions, setup shell script and dependency manifests
data_operations.data_scope: Dependency names, versions and registry archive locations
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: npm installer; its actual network payloads and filesystem operations are unresolved
data_operations.condition: When the operator runs the documented installation command or scripts/setup.sh

data_operations.operation: Configure persistent credentials and read local settings
data_operations.data_scope: GA4_PROPERTY_ID, GA4_CLIENT_EMAIL, GA4_PRIVATE_KEY, SEARCH_CONSOLE_SITE_URL and GA4_DEFAULT_DATE_RANGE
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Documented project-root .env; dotenv is invoked for the current working directory; getSettings returns selected values to its caller
data_operations.condition: Setup instructs credential persistence. Importing settings invokes dotenv; subsequent getSettings calls read environment variables and normalize private-key newlines

data_operations.operation: Configure authenticated SDK clients and cache client references
data_operations.data_scope: Service-account email and private key; Search Console and Indexing authentication both configure webmasters.readonly and indexing scopes
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Google SDK client/authentication objects in the local process; actual authentication exchanges are delegated to unavailable dependencies
data_operations.condition: First access to each client validates settings and constructs a singleton. resetClient clears cached references; it does not establish credential erasure

data_operations.source: Google Analytics Data API for the configured property
data_operations.data_scope: Property, dates, dimensions, metrics and optional limit are sent. Returned data can include paths/titles, sources/campaigns, country/device/browser aggregates, events, conversions, revenue and transactionId
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Google Analytics Data API receives query parameters; responses return to the calling process and save to results/reports when save is true
data_operations.condition: runReport or a report helper is called. Dates default to configured range or 30 days; filters and orderBy are accepted but omitted from the request. Demographics are retrieved attributes, not locally inferred individual profiles

data_operations.operation: Query GA4 metrics for selected paths
data_operations.source: Caller-provided paths and Google Analytics Data API
data_operations.data_scope: Trimmed paths with leading slashes, case-insensitive pagePath filter, property, dates, pagePath/pageTitle and requested or default metrics
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Google Analytics Data API; response returns to caller and defaults to persistence in results/reports
data_operations.condition: getMetricsForUrls receives a nonempty normalized list. Empty lists return empty rows without querying or saving

data_operations.data_scope: Property and requested fields; active users by screen, event counts, page views, or first-user source/medium
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Google Analytics Data API receives requests; returned responses stay with the caller and default to results/realtime persistence
data_operations.condition: The corresponding realtime helper is invoked; save=false suppresses its file write

data_operations.source: Google Analytics Data API metadata endpoint
data_operations.data_scope: Property metadata name; available dimension/metric definitions and full response on the full-metadata path
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Google Analytics Data API; selected or full metadata returns to caller and defaults to results/metadata persistence
data_operations.condition: A metadata helper is called. getAvailableFields calls the full-metadata helper

data_operations.data_scope: Configured site URL, dates, dimensions, row limit and offset; returned search queries/pages/device/country/search-appearance keys with clicks, impressions, CTR and position
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Google Search Console receives query parameters; response returns to caller and defaults to results/searchconsole persistence
data_operations.condition: querySearchAnalytics or its helpers are called. Custom queries default to 1000 rows; top queries/pages use 100 and countries use 50

data_operations.data_scope: Full supplied URL and URL_UPDATED or URL_DELETED; returned URL, notification type and notification time
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Google Indexing API; results return to caller and default to results/indexing persistence
data_operations.condition: requestIndexing, requestIndexingBatch or removeFromIndex is invoked. Batch requests run sequentially and suppress individual saves. URL_DELETED requests removal; it does not demonstrate actual deletion at Google or delete local result files

data_operations.operation: Inspect URLs and derive an indexed flag
data_operations.source: Caller URLs, configured site URL and Google Search Console inspection results
data_operations.data_scope: Inspection URL/site; index status, crawl and canonical details, inspection link, mobile issues and rich-result details. checkIndexStatus retains indexStatus and derives indexed from verdict === PASS; errors also produce indexed=false
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Google Search Console receives inspection requests; low-level results return to caller and default to results/indexing. checkIndexStatus saves its reduced batch result there
data_operations.condition: inspectUrl or checkIndexStatus is called; checkIndexStatus suppresses low-level saves

data_operations.operation: Compose analyses and save combined results
data_operations.source: Underlying report, realtime and Search Console helper results
data_operations.data_scope: Requested analysis components, including new/returning users, engagement, landing/exit pages and period comparisons
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Calling process and combined JSON in results/reports, results/realtime or results/searchconsole
data_operations.condition: High-level analysis functions are called. Most also allow child helpers to save separately; compareDateRanges explicitly disables both child saves

data_operations.operation: Persist result payloads and identifying metadata
data_operations.source: Data passed to saveResult and current settings
data_operations.data_scope: Complete passed payload plus savedAt, category, operation, GA4 propertyId and optional extraInfo; timestamp, operation and extraInfo also form the filename
data_operations.condition: saveResult is reached. Low-level APIs generally default save=true; high-level functions save unconditionally. Saving results is an explicit documented requirement; the metadata fields and duplicate copies are implementation choices

data_operations.operation: Read saved files and prescribe derived summaries
data_operations.source: Caller-selected JSON filepath or listed result category; documented analysis workflow
data_operations.data_scope: Saved JSON payloads and metadata, file paths, and derived tables, trends and recommendations
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: loadResult/listResults/getLatestResult return locally to their callers; the documented agent workflow writes markdown to results/summaries/
data_operations.condition: Storage utilities are invoked or the summary workflow is followed. Markdown generation is prescribed by SKILL.md but has no packaged implementation

data_operations.operation: Log dates and URLs; retain failure diagnostics
data_operations.source: Caller date ranges/URLs and caught exceptions
data_operations.data_scope: Comparison dates, complete indexing/inspection URLs, URL counts and status messages; String(error) in failed batch entries
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: console output for dates/URLs; error strings return in batch results and persist in results/indexing JSON
data_operations.condition: compareDateRanges, reindexUrls or checkIndexStatus executes; error strings are added only for caught failures. No external logging recipient is established

potential_excess.data_scope: Report rows outside caller-supplied dimension filters
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Calling process and, when save=true, results/reports JSON
potential_excess.condition: runReport receives filters intended to restrict the report; excess rows depend on actual property data
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The API documents dimension filters, but runReport destructures filters without including them in the Google request
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Retrieve and optionally save the requested filtered report
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Translate supported filters into the request, or reject unsupported filters before querying
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve requested dimensions, metrics, dates and limits; validate filter semantics rather than silently widening the query

potential_excess.data_scope: Duplicate copies of component report payloads already included in combined analyses
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Separate child JSON files alongside combined JSON in results/reports, results/realtime and results/searchconsole
potential_excess.condition: siteOverview, trafficAnalysis, contentPerformance, userBehavior, liveSnapshot, searchConsoleOverview, keywordAnalysis or seoPagePerformance completes child calls and its combined save
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Auto-saving analysis results is explicit; separately persisting every child and then the same data in a combined file is an implementation choice
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Keep a saved analysis usable by the summary workflow
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Suppress child saves within these orchestrators and retain the combined save. This removes redundant persistence, not the distinct required API queries
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep standalone helpers' save behavior and all combined result fields; expose save control through convenience helpers where needed

potential_excess.data_scope: GA4_PROPERTY_ID required locally and copied into Search Console and Indexing result metadata
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Search Console/Indexing client validation and results/searchconsole or results/indexing JSON; no transmission of this ID to those APIs is shown
potential_excess.condition: A Search Console or Indexing client is initialized, and those results are saved
potential_excess.purpose_basis: These paths use a site URL or submitted URL; shared GA4 validation and universal metadata introduce an unrelated property identifier
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Authenticate the applicable service and preserve its analysis or notification result
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use service-specific validation and omit GA4 propertyId from non-GA4 saved results
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain service-account credentials, Search Console site configuration where used, and GA4 property validation/metadata for GA4 operations

potential_excess.data_scope: Complete URLs copied into progress and failure messages, including any supplied query strings or fragments
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: console output; downstream log capture is unknown
potential_excess.condition: reindexUrls or checkIndexStatus processes each URL
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Submitting or inspecting URLs requires the URLs, but progress reporting does not require another full copy
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Send the supplied URL to the applicable Google API and report per-item progress/outcomes
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Log item ordinals and status rather than complete URLs
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve full URLs in required API requests and result associations; retain useful batch counts and failure status

potential_excess.data_scope: Unrestricted String(error) diagnostics in failed indexing and inspection entries
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Persisted results/indexing JSON and the normal batch return
potential_excess.condition: A caught exception contains details beyond those needed to identify the failed item and failure reason; actual exception contents are unavailable
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Failure reporting supports indexing/status checks, but the documented outcome does not require retaining arbitrary exception text
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Preserve the URL association, failure status and actionable reason
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Store an allowlisted error code and concise sanitized reason; make detailed diagnostics optional
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain enough information for retry or correction; do not assume exception strings contain credentials

potential_excess.data_scope: Top-page, device and country performance in addition to requested top search queries
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Additional Google Search Console queries; their responses enter the calling process, individual results/searchconsole files and the combined overview file
potential_excess.condition: The entry document's top-search-queries-only example is routed to searchConsoleOverview
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The quick-start mapping explicitly chooses a comprehensive helper for a narrow question. These components are appropriate for a comprehensive SEO overview, but unnecessary for the example's query-only outcome
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Retrieve top queries and their performance metrics, save the result and summarize it
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Route query-only requests to getTopQueries and reserve searchConsoleOverview for comprehensive requests
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep the comprehensive helper intact for broad SEO analysis; preserve the requested date range, query metrics and documented save/summary workflow

unknowns: Dependency implementations are not supplied. npm installation behavior, SDK authentication payloads/endpoints, retries, telemetry, logging and credential/token caching cannot be determined from manifests or lockfile entries.
Google-side storage, retention, downstream use and actual effects of indexing/removal notifications are undocumented here. A URL_DELETED notification does not establish deletion.

Actual runtime arguments, environment values, working directory, API responses and exception strings are unavailable. Whether URLs, titles, search queries or transaction identifiers contain personal data is unresolved.

The source provides no local result-retention or deletion mechanism. External cleanup, filesystem access controls, backups and console capture are unknown; clearing client references does not establish secure erasure.
Markdown summaries and resulting interpretations are instructed but not implemented in the package. Their actual contents and any agent-platform retention or disclosure remain unresolved.
